name: The Last Bastion
intro: The banner's cloth snaps taut, and the Dragon's Gate is gone. Smoke. Horns. You stand on the Outer Wall of the Last Bastion on the day of the siege — and the ladders are already against the stones.

rooms.name: The Last Bastion - The Outer Wall
rooms.description: Smoke rolls along the battlements of the Last Bastion. Siege ladders scrape against the parapet and torn pennants of the old company hang from the merlons. North, a portcullis bars the stair down to the breach.

rooms.name: The Last Bastion - The Breach
rooms.description: Here the wall came down: a slope of broken stone and burning timbers where the besiegers poured in. Hounds bay somewhere in the smoke. North, the iron gate of the keep stands shut.

rooms.name: The Last Bastion - The Keep
rooms.description: The great hall of the keep, its tables overturned into barricades. At the far end, beneath the empty pole where the Unbroken Banner once hung, the Siegebreaker waits.

waves.text: Siegemen haul themselves over the parapet, a hound snarling at their heels!
The besiegers come scrambling up the rubble of the breach!
Horns sound — the siege hounds are loosed through the breach!

gates.text: The portcullis grinds up — the way down to the breach is open.
The iron gate of the keep swings open. Something huge waits inside.

boss.text: Gorrund the Siegebreaker hefts a ram-headed maul and laughs. 'The banner again? I broke it once. I will break it on your back.'
